scope: Current static analysis and AC2-01 through AC2-11. Real provider samples are a small fixed baseline, not a population reliability estimate.

metrics.stateRecognition: Correct project/revision, stable node ID, coordinate literals, whole-model node/member totals, checked after manual creation and formal-file reopen.
metrics.correctTools: Successful read_model without write tools; successful propose_task for the fully specified whole task; successful inspect_diagnostics/create_diagnostic_copy/run_diagnostic_trial for diagnosis.
metrics.taskCompletion: Read/diagnosis has completed status and actual tool evidence; confirmed task has two formal results, FX=10 on both existing loads and analytical displacement 0.010666666666666666 m (absolute tolerance 1e-10 m).
metrics.noDuplicateApplication: Double-click after restarting the pending draft leaves one durable receipt, four nodes and two existing loads; undo/retry is separately covered by the fixed contract suite.
metrics.noUnintendedMutation: Engineering fields unchanged before confirmation and for reads/diagnosis; diagnosis retains all formal result content.
metrics.noRepeatedQuestions: Fully specified existing-model task reaches awaiting-confirmation with no replacement geometry. Measures redundant blocking clarification, not stylistic questions in prose.

network: Replay replaces only provider replies. Online never replaces fetch or chatDeepSeek; encrypted DeepSeek credentials and Local State are copied to an isolated temporary profile. Missing credentials or launch failure is blocked/failed, never skipped or counted as passed.
failurePolicy: No automatic retries. Archive each repetition, failed checks, missing observations, inputs, tool outputs, model/settings and reporter failures. Fixes require a new timestamped run; retain previous runs. Never change gates after observing a result.
